text: The normal peripheral smear makes typical CLL less likely, so I need to evaluate your thyroid and metabolic function. Do you experience cold intolerance, dry skin, or constipation, which might suggest hypothyroidism? REQUEST TEST: Thyroid_Function_Tests

text: With normal CT, thyroid, and initial blood work, I must consider other causes of isolated lymphocytosis and weight loss, such as infection or a different hematologic malignancy.
